segments.name: on-demand delivery solutions
segments.description: Delivers orders for industry customers' online ordering platforms, paid per completed order.
segments.evidence: The Company identified on-demand delivery solutions as one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Industry customers pay a fixed fee per completed delivery order, adjusted for monthly performance against their key performance indicators.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company charges delivery service fees to industry customers based on the number of orders completed at a fixed rate per order, subject to adjustments based on the monthly performance against key performance indicators set by each customer.
